# Action Camera Blog

> > A photography blog covering camera gear reviews, photography fundamentals, and practical shooting techniques for Sony, Canon, and Fujifilm systems.

Action Camera Blog features in-depth tutorials on photography basics (aperture, shutter speed, sensor formats), technical guides on file formats and memory cards, gear reviews focusing on mirrorless cameras and lenses, and practical shooting challenges for photographers of all levels.

## Key Topics

- Sony mirrorless cameras
- Canon cameras
- Fujifilm X-series
- Photography basics (aperture, shutter speed, exposure)
- Full frame vs APS-C sensors
- Lens reviews (Sony 35mm f/1.4 GM)
- HEIC/HEIF vs JPEG formats
- RAW photography
- Low-light photography
- Portrait photography
- Landscape photography
- Memory card speed classes
- YouTube camera community
- Northern California photography
- Photography challenges

## Photography Fundamentals

- [Understanding Aperture and Depth of Field](https://actioncamera.blog/2017/02/09/aperture-and-depth-of-field): Photography basics tutorial on aperture and depth of field
- [Shutter Speed](https://actioncamera.blog/2017/02/14/shutter-speed): Photography basics tutorial on shutter speed and motion blur
- [Full Frame vs. Crop: What you should know](https://actioncamera.blog/2019/03/11/full-frame-vs-crop-what-you-should-know): Comprehensive guide comparing full frame vs APS-C sensor cameras

## Technical Guides & Gear Knowledge

- [What the HEIC?](https://actioncamera.blog/2022/06/30/what-the-heic): Demystifying HEIC/HEIF file formats vs JPEG for Canon and Sony cameras
- [Memory Card Speed Classes & Designations Demystified](https://actioncamera.blog/2020/12/19/memory-card-speed-classes-designations-demystified): Guide to memory card speed classes and designations for cameras
- [Sony A7S III: Why only 12 megapixels? Are 12MP enough?](https://actioncamera.blog/2020/08/19/sony-a7s-iii-why-ony-12-megapixels-is-12mp-enough): Explanation of Sony A7S III 12MP sensor choice for video quality

## Photography Tutorials & Techniques

- [Tips for Photographing Live Music](https://actioncamera.blog/2018/06/09/photographing-live-music): Concert photography tips for live music and stage photography
- [Beauty Headshots: Two Lights & No Background](https://actioncamera.blog/2017/03/13/beautyheadshots): Studio lighting tutorial for two-light beauty headshot setup
- [Shoot the Moon](https://actioncamera.blog/2018/10/31/shoot-the-moon): Moon photography tutorial with exposure settings and techniques
- [Candle Light Portrait: Tips & Challenge](https://actioncamera.blog/2021/03/24/candle-light-portrait-tips-challenge): Tips and challenge for candle light portrait photography

## Camera & Lens Reviews

- [Fujifilm X-T4 Announced](https://actioncamera.blog/2020/03/04/fujifilm-x-t4-announced): Announcement coverage of Fujifilm X-T4 mirrorless camera with IBIS
- [Fuji X-T2 First Impressions](https://actioncamera.blog/2017/02/18/fuji-x-t2): First impressions review of Fuji X-T2 shot at Yosemite Valley
- [Camping with Zeiss](https://actioncamera.blog/2017/08/11/zeiss-12mm): Zeiss Touit 12mm lens review from camping at California coast
- [The YouTube Camera Community: Via the Sony 35mm f/1.4 GM](https://actioncamera.blog/2021/01/20/the-youtube-camera-community-via-the-sony-35mm-f-1-4-gm): Commentary on YouTube camera reviewers covering Sony 35mm f/1.4 GM lens

## Photography Challenges & Projects

- [Stuck at Home – A-Z Challenge](https://actioncamera.blog/2020/03/13/stuck-at-home-a-z-challenge): COVID-19 home photography A-Z challenge for stuck photographers
